say:0:1322446001:0.text: The ritual's almost here. I'm really worried about Irina.
say:0:1322446001:0.source_cn: 祭祀的日期快要到了，我好担心伊琳娜。

say:1:1322446002:0.text: Yeah, that drunk father of hers looks completely unreliable. Chippy has to go check on her!
say:1:1322446002:0.source_cn: 是啊，她的酒鬼父亲一副不靠谱的样子，满满要亲自去看看才...

narration:0:1322446101:1.text: You knock on the door, but no one answers...

say:1:1322447001:1.text: Oh no... the door's locked, and there's no sound from inside!
say:1:1322447001:1.source_cn: 糟了……门窗都锁着，里面也没有一点动静！

say:2:1322447002:1.text: That drunk! We told him to keep an eye on Irina!
say:2:1322447002:1.source_cn: 那个醉汉！明明叮嘱过他要看住伊琳娜的！

choice_prompt:3:1322447002.text: That drunk! We told him to keep an eye on Irina!
choice_prompt:3:1322447002.source_cn: 那个醉汉！明明叮嘱过他要看住伊琳娜的！

say:4:1322447003:1.text: Magister, Chippy's got a bad feeling. I think Irina's already fallen into the hands of those cultists. We have to save her.
say:4:1322447003:1.source_cn: 主人，满满有种不好的预感，伊琳娜一定被那些邪教徒骗走了...
say:4:1322447003:1.male: Magister, Chippy's got a bad feeling. I think Irina's already fallen into the hands of those cultists. We have to save her.
say:4:1322447003:1.female: Magister, Chippy's got a bad feeling. I think Irina's already fallen into the hands of those cultists. We have to save her.

say:5:1322447004:1.text: We can't act rashly. Let's check with Rodrigo first.
say:5:1322447004:1.source_cn: 不能贸然行动，事前还是找罗德里戈打声招呼。

say:1:1322448001:1.source_cn: 什么，您说伊琳娜不见了？

say:2:1322448002:1.text: This means the cultists have already made their move, and the ritual is about to start...
say:2:1322448002:1.source_cn: 这意味着邪教徒已经行动了，看来祭祀即将开始……

say:3:1322448003:1.text: I'll gather the guards. This time, we'll wipe out every last one of those cultists!
say:3:1322448003:1.source_cn: 我这就召集侍卫们，这次一定要剿灭所有邪教徒！

say:4:1322448004:1.text: You don't need to worry about Irina. I've got my eyes on her.
say:4:1322448004:1.source_cn: 伊琳娜的事请您放心，我会额外的留意的。
say:4:1322448004:1.male: You don't need to worry about Irina. I've got my eyes on her.
say:4:1322448004:1.female: You don't need to worry about Irina. I've got my eyes on her.

choice_prompt:5:1322448004.text: You don't need to worry about Irina. I've got my eyes on her.
choice_prompt:5:1322448004.source_cn: 伊琳娜的事请您放心，我会额外的留意的。
choice_prompt:5:1322448004.male: You don't need to worry about Irina. I've got my eyes on her.
choice_prompt:5:1322448004.female: You don't need to worry about Irina. I've got my eyes on her.

say:6:1322448005:1.text: You've already done more than enough...
say:6:1322448005:1.male: You've already done more than enough...
say:6:1322448005:1.female: You've already done more than enough...

say:8:1322448006:1.text: No! We're doing this. Sir Chippy to the rescue!
say:8:1322448006:1.source_cn: 不行，骑士满满一定要去救人！

say:9:1322448007:1.text: Thank you, Magister. With your help, I'm sure we'll get every last one of them!
say:9:1322448007:1.source_cn: 那就麻烦你们了，魔法师大人。有你们的加入，这次一定可以...

say:1:1322458001:1.source_cn: 向你的英勇致敬，魔法师大人。

choice_prompt:2:1322458001.source_cn: 向你的英勇致敬，魔法师大人。

say:3:1322458002:1.text: Captain, we've got all the cultists under control.
say:3:1322458002:1.source_cn: 罗德里戈大人，所有邪教徒都被我们控制住了。

say:4:1322458003:1.text: Lock them up. Keep a close watch on them until their trial.
say:4:1322458003:1.source_cn: 将他们全数关入监牢，等待审判。看好他们。

say:9:1322458006:1.text: I... I don't want to go to the ritual... I'm scared...

say:10:1322458007:1.text: I couldn't stop myself... I was terrified... but I still ended up here...
say:10:1322458007:1.source_cn: 但我控制不了……自己，好害怕……但还是，走到这里了……

say:11:1322458008:1.text: Sounds like she's under some kind of spell...
say:11:1322458008:1.source_cn: 听起来像是被魔法控制了……

choice_prompt:12:1322458008.text: Sounds like she's under some kind of spell...
choice_prompt:12:1322458008.source_cn: 听起来像是被魔法控制了……

say:13:1322458009:1.text: Are you saying these villagers were all controlled by dark magic?! Outrageous!
say:13:1322458009:1.source_cn: 难道这些镇民都被黑魔控制了行动？太可恶了！

say:14:1322458011:1.text: Look, Irina's eyes! They're clear again!
say:14:1322458011:1.source_cn: 看，伊琳娜的眼神变清澈了！

choice_prompt:15:1322458011.text: Look, Irina's eyes! They're clear again!
choice_prompt:15:1322458011.source_cn: 看，伊琳娜的眼神变清澈了！

say:16:1322458012:1.text: It's you... I've seen you before... Thank you...
say:16:1322458012:1.male: It's you... I've seen you before... Thank you...
say:16:1322458012:1.female: It's you... I've seen you before... Thank you...

say:19:1322458015:1.text: Zaneus has been arrested. We'll escort the villagers back to Cedartown.
say:19:1322458015:1.source_cn: 兹比格涅夫已经被逮捕，我们会护送这些镇民回雪松镇。
say:19:1322458015:1.male: Zaneus has been arrested. We'll escort the villagers back to Cedartown.
say:19:1322458015:1.female: Zaneus has been arrested. We'll escort the villagers back to Cedartown.

say:20:1322458016:1.text: Magister, some of the villagers still haven't shaken off the effects of the dark magic. Perhaps you could help?
say:20:1322458016:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，还有一些镇民的黑魔法症状没有消失，或许你可...
say:20:1322458016:1.male: Magister, some of the villagers still haven't shaken off the effects of the dark magic. Perhaps you could help?
say:20:1322458016:1.female: Magister, some of the villagers still haven't shaken off the effects of the dark magic. Perhaps you could help?

choice_prompt:21:1322458016.text: Magister, some of the villagers still haven't shaken off the effects of the dark magic. Perhaps you could help?
choice_prompt:21:1322458016.source_cn: 魔法师大人，还有一些镇民的黑魔法症状没有消失，或许你可以帮帮他们。
choice_prompt:21:1322458016.male: Magister, some of the villagers still haven't shaken off the effects of the dark magic. Perhaps you could help?
choice_prompt:21:1322458016.female: Magister, some of the villagers still haven't shaken off the effects of the dark magic. Perhaps you could help?

say:26:1322458014:1.text: Yes, Zaneus actually turned people into Hypofiends in front of everyone. That's insane!
say:26:1322458014:1.source_cn: 是的，兹比格涅夫竟然当着镇民的面把人变成了魔物……真是...

choice:15:2:3.source_cn: 镇民们的执念也消散了

say:28:1322458010:1.text: So that's it... all these villagers were chosen, too? That's terrifying...
say:28:1322458010:1.source_cn: 原来是这样……这里的镇民一定都是被选中的祭品，好可怕啊……

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 看来伊琳娜是被选中的祭品

say:1:1322459001:0.text: Stay calm. We're here to help you.
say:1:1322459001:0.source_cn: 冷静点，我们是来救你的。

say:3:1322459003:1.text: I saw people turning into Hypofiends! We'll all end up like them!
say:3:1322459003:1.source_cn: 我看到很多镇民都变魔物了！所有人都会变的！

choice_prompt:4:1322459003.text: I saw people turning into Hypofiends! We'll all end up like them!
choice_prompt:4:1322459003.source_cn: 我看到很多镇民都变魔物了！所有人都会变的！

say:5:1322459004:1.source_cn: 引导者兹比格涅夫，不……那个畜生……

say:6:1322459005:1.text: He turned these innocent people into Hypofiends!
say:6:1322459005:1.source_cn: 那个畜生把镇民们都变成了魔物！

say:7:1322459008:1.text: So this ritual... it was all the cult's doing?
say:7:1322459008:1.source_cn: 所以……举办这场祭祀的都是邪教徒？

say:8:1322459009:1.text: We were all part of the ritual... tricked by the cultists...
say:8:1322459009:1.source_cn: 我们也是……来参加这场祭祀的都是邪教徒……

say:9:1322459010:1.source_cn: 你说得对，但接下来不会再是了。

say:11:1322459011:1.text: Magister, their eyes are clearing up, too!
say:11:1322459011:1.source_cn: 主人，他们的眼睛看起来也变清澈了！
say:11:1322459011:1.male: Magister, their eyes are clearing up, too!
say:11:1322459011:1.female: Magister, their eyes are clearing up, too!

choice_prompt:12:1322459011.text: Magister, their eyes are clearing up, too!
choice_prompt:12:1322459011.source_cn: 主人，他们的眼睛看起来也变清澈了！
choice_prompt:12:1322459011.male: Magister, their eyes are clearing up, too!
choice_prompt:12:1322459011.female: Magister, their eyes are clearing up, too!

say:13:1322459012:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's do another sweep of the area and see if there's anything else corrupted by dark magic.
say:13:1322459012:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's do another sweep of the area and see if there's anything else corrupted by dark magic.
say:13:1322459012:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's do another sweep of the area and see if there's anything else corrupted by dark magic.

say:15:1322459006:1.text: Zaneus, that scumbag! He deceived all of us!
say:15:1322459006:1.source_cn: 兹比格涅夫那个混账！他骗了我们所有人！

say:16:1322459007:1.text: You mean... Zaneus's been brought to justice? Thank the gods...
say:16:1322459007:1.source_cn: 你是说……兹比格涅夫被抓起来了吗？太好了……
say:16:1322459007:1.male: You mean... Zaneus's been brought to justice? Thank the gods...
say:16:1322459007:1.female: You mean... Zaneus's been brought to justice? Thank the gods...

choice:4:2:3.source_cn: 不会有镇民再变成魔物了

say:0:1322460001:0.text: Dark magic... syndicate... Could it be the Adamant Syndicate again?!
say:0:1322460001:0.source_cn: 黑魔法……商会……难道又是黑金商会！

say:1:1322460002:0.source_cn: 一群唯恐天下不乱的恶徒……

say:0:1322461001:0.text: Huh? Whose package is this? Let's take it back and ask around.
say:0:1322461001:0.source_cn: 咦，这包裹是哪位镇民落下的？回去问问吧。

say:1:1322462001:1.text: The villagers don't know what to do. They're confused...
say:1:1322462001:1.source_cn: 这位大人，镇民们都有点不知所措……
say:1:1322462001:1.male: The villagers don't know what to do. They're confused...
say:1:1322462001:1.female: The villagers don't know what to do. They're confused...

choice_prompt:2:1322462001.text: The villagers don't know what to do. They're confused...
choice_prompt:2:1322462001.source_cn: 这位大人，镇民们都有点不知所措……
choice_prompt:2:1322462001.male: The villagers don't know what to do. They're confused...
choice_prompt:2:1322462001.female: The villagers don't know what to do. They're confused...

say:3:1322462002:1.text: Everyone's in shock. Too scared to move. They just want to go back with you.
say:3:1322462002:1.source_cn: 大家都吓坏了，不敢动弹，都想着和您一起回去。
say:3:1322462002:1.male: Everyone's in shock. Too scared to move. They just want to go back with you.
say:3:1322462002:1.female: Everyone's in shock. Too scared to move. They just want to go back with you.

say:4:1322462003:1.text: Thank you for saving us! We were so close to becoming Hypofiends...
say:4:1322462003:1.source_cn: 多亏了您啊，真不敢想刚才离变成魔物就差那么一点点……
say:4:1322462003:1.male: Thank you for saving us! We were so close to becoming Hypofiends...
say:4:1322462003:1.female: Thank you for saving us! We were so close to becoming Hypofiends...

say:5:1322462004:1.text: Alright, alright, no more talk of Hypofiends. Let's head back with the Magister first...
say:5:1322462004:1.source_cn: 好啦好啦，不要再提魔物了，先跟大人回去吧……

say:1:1322464001:1.text: Thanks to you, all the cultists have been arrested. They'll be facing trial soon.
say:1:1322464001:1.source_cn: 多亏您的协助，邪教徒全数被逮捕了，很快他们会接受法庭的审判。
say:1:1322464001:1.male: Thanks to you, all the cultists have been arrested. They'll be facing trial soon.
say:1:1322464001:1.female: Thanks to you, all the cultists have been arrested. They'll be facing trial soon.

choice_prompt:2:1322464001.text: Thanks to you, all the cultists have been arrested. They'll be facing trial soon.
choice_prompt:2:1322464001.source_cn: 多亏您的协助，邪教徒全数被逮捕了，很快他们会接受法庭的审判。
choice_prompt:2:1322464001.male: Thanks to you, all the cultists have been arrested. They'll be facing trial soon.
choice_prompt:2:1322464001.female: Thanks to you, all the cultists have been arrested. They'll be facing trial soon.

say:3:1322464002:1.text: Until the new Archduke arrives, I'll do my best to maintain order here in Whiteridge.
say:3:1322464002:1.source_cn: 在新的大公到来之前，我会尽可能的维系白山的秩序。
say:3:1322464002:1.male: Until the new Archduke arrives, I'll do my best to maintain order here in Whiteridge.
say:3:1322464002:1.female: Until the new Archduke arrives, I'll do my best to maintain order here in Whiteridge.

say:4:1322464003:1.text: But... like my ancestors, I once swore an oath to serve the Valesa family. Now, with the last of them gone...
say:4:1322464003:1.source_cn: 不过……我和我的祖先一样，都曾立下誓言，效忠于瓦勒沙家...
say:4:1322464003:1.male: But... like my ancestors, I once swore an oath to serve the Valesa family. Now, with the last of them gone...
say:4:1322464003:1.female: But... like my ancestors, I once swore an oath to serve the Valesa family. Now, with the last of them gone...

say:5:1322464004:1.text: My family's mission has come to an end. Once the new Archduke is here... perhaps I'll become a wandering knight.
say:5:1322464004:1.source_cn: 我的家族使命也到此结束了，等到新的大公到来之后……或许...
say:5:1322464004:1.male: My family's mission has come to an end. Once the new Archduke is here... perhaps I'll become a wandering knight.
say:5:1322464004:1.female: My family's mission has come to an end. Once the new Archduke is here... perhaps I'll become a wandering knight.

say:6:1322464005:1.text: Who knows, maybe our paths will cross again one day.
say:6:1322464005:1.source_cn: 也许在未来的旅途中，我们还会再见面。
say:6:1322464005:1.male: Who knows, maybe our paths will cross again one day.
say:6:1322464005:1.female: Who knows, maybe our paths will cross again one day.

say:7:1322464006:1.text: But for now, I'm just grateful for everything you've done—not only for Whiteridge but for me, as a friend.
say:7:1322464006:1.source_cn: 无论如何，感激您为白山所做的……也感激您为我这个朋友做...
say:7:1322464006:1.male: But for now, I'm just grateful for everything you've done—not only for Whiteridge but for me, as a friend.
say:7:1322464006:1.female: But for now, I'm just grateful for everything you've done—not only for Whiteridge but for me, as a friend.

say:1:1322465001:0.text: Thanks to you, Whiteridge is back on its feet.
say:1:1322465001:0.source_cn: 多亏了你，白山重回了正轨。
say:1:1322465001:0.male: Thanks to you, Whiteridge is back on its feet.
say:1:1322465001:0.female: Thanks to you, Whiteridge is back on its feet.

say:2:1322465002:0.text: And my work is finally starting to show results. The villagers are being freed from their delusions, and their faith is being restored.
say:2:1322465002:0.source_cn: 我的工作也有了成效，镇民们正逐渐从执念中走出来，信仰问...

say:3:1322465003:2.text: That's good to hear! Now the cult won't have any ground to stand on!
say:3:1322465003:2.source_cn: 太好了，这样邪教就没有了萌发的土壤！

say:5:1322465005:1.text: I've sent word to the Lightbearer Temple, asking for their help with the investigation. It won't be easy to dig into a court mage, but we'll find a way.
say:5:1322465005:1.source_cn: 我已经传信给耀光圣堂，请他们协助调查。虽然想要调查一位...

say:6:1322465006:1.text: Oh, and there's one more thing.

say:7:1322465007:1.text: It seems the cultists mostly targeted villagers who were struggling in life. The temple will be paying extra attention to those people moving forward.
say:7:1322465007:1.source_cn: 我发现受到蛊惑的邪教徒多是生活中不顺意的镇民，圣堂接下...

say:8:1322465008:1.text: Maybe... you'd want to come visit the villagers with me?
say:8:1322465008:1.source_cn: 也许……你愿意和我一起去探望这些镇民？
say:8:1322465008:1.male: Maybe... you'd want to come visit the villagers with me?
say:8:1322465008:1.female: Maybe... you'd want to come visit the villagers with me?

choice_prompt:9:1322465008.text: Maybe... you'd want to come visit the villagers with me?
choice_prompt:9:1322465008.source_cn: 也许……你愿意和我一起去探望这些镇民？
choice_prompt:9:1322465008.male: Maybe... you'd want to come visit the villagers with me?
choice_prompt:9:1322465008.female: Maybe... you'd want to come visit the villagers with me?

say:10:1322465009:1.text: You're every bit as kind as I remember.
say:10:1322465009:1.source_cn: 和我记忆中的一样，你总是如此慷慨。
say:10:1322465009:1.male: You're every bit as kind as I remember.
say:10:1322465009:1.female: You're every bit as kind as I remember.

say:1:1322467001:1.text: Everyone, this is the hero who saved you all, <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:1:1322467001:1.source_cn: 各位，这位就是救过你们的魔法师大人，<style=st...
say:1:1322467001:1.male: Everyone, this is the hero who saved you all, <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:1:1322467001:1.female: Everyone, this is the hero who saved you all, <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:2:1322467002:1.text: You came to see us... Thank you...
say:2:1322467002:1.male: You came to see us... Thank you...
say:2:1322467002:1.female: You came to see us... Thank you...

say:3:1322467003:1.text: We're forever in your debt, great hero...
say:3:1322467003:1.source_cn: 上次可太感谢您了……您可是我们的大恩人呐。
say:3:1322467003:1.male: We're forever in your debt, great hero...
say:3:1322467003:1.female: We're forever in your debt, great hero...

choice_prompt:4:1322467003.text: We're forever in your debt, great hero...
choice_prompt:4:1322467003.source_cn: 上次可太感谢您了……您可是我们的大恩人呐。
choice_prompt:4:1322467003.male: We're forever in your debt, great hero...
choice_prompt:4:1322467003.female: We're forever in your debt, great hero...

say:5:1322467004:1.text: Those cultists preyed on our misfortunes, tricked us with lies... In the end, it was our own greed that got us into this mess.
say:5:1322467004:1.source_cn: 那些邪教徒利用了我们的不幸，用那些花言巧语诱惑我们……...

say:6:1322467005:1.text: There's no such thing as a free lunch in the world.
say:6:1322467005:1.source_cn: 这世上哪有不劳而获的道理呢？

say:7:1322467006:1.text: Who could've known it was a dark ritual? If not for you, we would've turned into Hypofiends by now.
say:7:1322467006:1.source_cn: 谁也想不到，那竟然是一场黑暗仪式，如果不是大人您，我们...
say:7:1322467006:1.male: Who could've known it was a dark ritual? If not for you, we would've turned into Hypofiends by now.
say:7:1322467006:1.female: Who could've known it was a dark ritual? If not for you, we would've turned into Hypofiends by now.

choice_prompt:8:1322467006.text: Who could've known it was a dark ritual? If not for you, we would've turned into Hypofiends by now.
choice_prompt:8:1322467006.source_cn: 谁也想不到，那竟然是一场黑暗仪式，如果不是大人您，我们早已沦为魔物了。
choice_prompt:8:1322467006.male: Who could've known it was a dark ritual? If not for you, we would've turned into Hypofiends by now.
choice_prompt:8:1322467006.female: Who could've known it was a dark ritual? If not for you, we would've turned into Hypofiends by now.

say:9:1322467007:1.text: I want to see them pay for what they did!
say:9:1322467007:1.source_cn: 我现在恨不得跟这群人同归于尽！

say:10:1322467008:1.text: Thankfully, the children didn't fall for their lies. Turns out, they're the clearest-headed of all in Cedartown!
say:10:1322467008:1.source_cn: 是啊……好在孩子们没有轻信这群恶徒，雪松镇原来最清醒的...

say:12:1322467012:1.text: By the way, did any of you drop this?
say:12:1322467012:1.source_cn: 对了，这个包裹……请问这是你们谁落下的吗？

say:15:1322467015:1.text: Magister, could it be Irina's? We were going to visit her anyway.
say:15:1322467015:1.source_cn: 主人，这也许是伊琳娜的？我们正好去探望下她！
say:15:1322467015:1.male: Magister, could it be Irina's? We were going to visit her anyway.
say:15:1322467015:1.female: Magister, could it be Irina's? We were going to visit her anyway.

say:17:1322467009:1.text: From now on, we need to be extra cautious about sweet talkers!
say:17:1322467009:1.source_cn: 当然，接下来任何花言巧语都要防范！

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 让更多镇民引以为戒吧

say:18:1322467010:1.text: You've already done more than enough for this town. We can't ask for anything more from you. Just make sure to stop by every now and then.
say:18:1322467010:1.source_cn: 您已经为镇子做的够多了，有空能多来看看我们就好了。
say:18:1322467010:1.male: You've already done more than enough for this town. We can't ask for anything more from you. Just make sure to stop by every now and then.
say:18:1322467010:1.female: You've already done more than enough for this town. We can't ask for anything more from you. Just make sure to stop by every now and then.

say:19:1322467011:1.text: Yeah, having someone as capable as you around makes everyone feel a lot safer.
say:19:1322467011:1.source_cn: 是啊，能看到您这么神通广大的人在身边，大家都能安心。
say:19:1322467011:1.male: Yeah, having someone as capable as you around makes everyone feel a lot safer.
say:19:1322467011:1.female: Yeah, having someone as capable as you around makes everyone feel a lot safer.

choice:4:0:1.text: It's nothing, don't worry about it.
choice:4:0:1.male: It's nothing, don't worry about it.
choice:4:0:1.female: It's nothing, don't worry about it.

choice:4:1:2.text: As long as you're all okay, that's all that matters.
choice:4:1:2.male: As long as you're all okay, that's all that matters.
choice:4:1:2.female: As long as you're all okay, that's all that matters.

say:0:1322468001:0.text: I see Irina! She's right over there!
say:0:1322468001:0.source_cn: 我看到伊琳娜了，她在那！

say:1:1322469001:1.text: This... This is from Lev, my friend.

picture:2::2.source_cn: 名为《轻松掌握咕咕语》的书籍

say:3:1322469003:1.text: I... I can't bear to look at it. Could... could you... read it for me?
say:3:1322469003:1.source_cn: 伊琳娜不敢看……能……拜托……你们……读给我。

document:5:159:0.text:
Month ?? Day ??
I ended up in a place called Cedartown. My legs were frostbitten, and no one seemed to notice me. I hadn't eaten in days.
When I was about to pass out, a girl brought me water and food. She even lit a fire to keep me warm.
Her name was Irina.

Month ?? Day ??
Irina and I became friends. She has trouble speaking and comes across as cold, but I can tell she's kind and wants to connect with people.

Month ?? Day ??
She took care of me until my fever broke and I got my strength back. I don't know how to thank her, so I sang for her.

Month ?? Day ??
I met someone strange who told me about the Great Will. If it's real, maybe it can help me repay Irina and heal her speech.

Month ?? Day ??
The acolyte told me that the ritual can heal Irina. If that's true, I'll pay any price to have her healed...
document:5:159:0.source_cn:
■月■日，我来到一个叫雪松镇的地方，我的腿被冻伤了，没人注意到自己，我已经快四天没吃东西了。
当我意识模糊时，一个女孩送来了水和食物，还生了火。
她叫伊琳娜。

■月■日，伊琳娜和我成为了朋友，她讲话有障碍，虽然脸上表情冷冷的，但我发现她内心很温柔，渴望与他人沟通。

■月■日，在伊琳娜的照顾下，我恢复了一些体力，烧也退了，我不知道该怎么报答她，只能为她唱歌。

■月■日，我接触到一个神秘的人，他向我告知了伟大意志的存在，也许我可以通过伟大意志来报答伊琳娜，治好她的口疾。

■月■日，传教士大人告诉我，在祭祀上就可以获得治愈伊琳娜的方法，只要他们说的是真的，无论什么代价我愿意承受。

say:7:1322469005:0.text: *Sobbing* Lev... Lev... what happened to him...
say:7:1322469005:0.source_cn: 呜呜……列夫哥哥……列夫哥哥他……

say:8:1322469004:0.text: "The priest told me that the ritual can heal Irina... If that's true, I'll pay any price to have her healed..."
say:8:1322469004:0.source_cn: “传教士大人告诉我，在祭祀上就可以获得治愈伊琳娜的方法...

say:9:1322469006:0.text: Does this mean... I'll never... see him again?

choice_prompt:10:1322469003.text: I... I can't bear to look at it. Could... could you... read it for me?
choice_prompt:10:1322469003.source_cn: 伊琳娜不敢看……能……拜托……你们……读给我。

say:14:1322469010:1.text: Irina, Lev used to sing to you, didn't he?
say:14:1322469010:1.source_cn: 伊琳娜，列夫曾给你唱过歌，对吗？

say:16:1322469012:1.text: It might be a bit too much to ask, but... would you be willing to sing one of the songs he used to sing to you?
say:16:1322469012:1.source_cn: 也许有些让你有些为难，但你能为我唱一首列夫唱过的歌吗？

say:18:1322469014:1.text: I know, but I think it's worth a try.
say:18:1322469014:1.source_cn: 我知道，但我希望伊琳娜试一试。

say:20:1322469016:1.text: The wind and snow... the child of wind and snow, we wait for you to come home.
say:20:1322469016:1.source_cn: 风和雪……风和雪的孩子啊，我们在等你回家。

say:21:1322469017:1.text: Here, there's hot food and mama. Here, flowers bloom for you.
say:21:1322469017:1.source_cn: 这里有热腾腾的料理和妈妈，这里有为你盛开的花。

say:22:1322469018:1.text: The child of wind and snow, we wait for you to come home.
say:22:1322469018:1.source_cn: 风和雪的孩子啊，我们在等你回家。

say:23:1322469019:1.text: You've gone to a place I can't see. Please, come back to us soon.
say:23:1322469019:1.source_cn: 你飘到了我看不到的地方，所以请你快些回答。

say:24:1322469020:1.text: The child of wind and snow, are you still wandering out there?
say:24:1322469020:1.source_cn: 风和雪的孩子啊，你还在外面流浪吗？

say:25:1322469021:1.text: On your way home, don't be lonely, don't be afraid.
say:25:1322469021:1.source_cn: 归来的路上，不要孤独，不要害怕。

say:27:1322469022:2.text: Wow! I'm getting a little teary-eyed here! That was beautiful!
say:27:1322469022:2.source_cn: 哇！我听完鼻子酸酸的！唱得真好！

choice_prompt:28:1322469022.text: Wow! I'm getting a little teary-eyed here! That was beautiful!
choice_prompt:28:1322469022.source_cn: 哇！我听完鼻子酸酸的！唱得真好！

say:29:1322469023:0.text: I'm really moved, too... I had no idea Irina could sing so well!
say:29:1322469023:0.source_cn: 虽然我也很感动……但是伊琳娜竟然唱歌这么流畅？

say:31:1322469026:1.text: Just like I thought, some of the children at the temple have a speech condition similar to Irina's. We've been trying to teach them hymns to help them speak properly again.
say:31:1322469026:1.source_cn: 果然应验了我的猜测，圣堂中有一些孩子和伊琳娜有相似的口...

say:32:1322469027:1.text: It's not easy. Some of them can't even get the first song right, no matter how hard they try.
say:32:1322469027:1.source_cn: 他们学唱歌非常艰难，有些孩子无论怎么努力都无法学会第一首歌。

say:33:1322469028:1.text: But some of them... after practicing for a while, they start speaking like they never had a problem.
say:33:1322469028:1.source_cn: 但也有不少孩子通过练习歌曲，最后可以恢复到像正常人一样讲话。

say:35:1322469029:0.text: So, in a way, Lev really did cure Irina, didn't he?!
say:35:1322469029:0.source_cn: 这么说！列夫真的治好了伊琳娜！

say:36:1322469030:1.text: In a way, yes. Irina... would you come back with me to the temple?
say:36:1322469030:1.source_cn: 某种意义上是的，伊琳娜，你愿意跟我回圣堂吗？

say:37:1322469031:1.text: I... I don't want to be a burden...

say:38:1322469032:1.text: Irina, your song moved me so deeply. This isn't out of pity. It's a genuine invitation.
say:38:1322469032:1.source_cn: 你刚才的歌声很令我感动，这一切并不是处于对你的怜悯，这...

say:39:1322469033:1.text: Irina, you almost made me cry with that song! You've got an amazing voice!
say:39:1322469033:1.source_cn: 伊琳娜，我刚才都差点被你唱哭啦！你的歌声真的很好听！

say:41:1322469034:1.text: That's right! So please say yes!

say:44:1322469036:0.text: It was like telling a story! Almost had me in tears!
say:44:1322469036:0.source_cn: 是的！像是叙述着一个故事一般！非常感动！

say:45:1322469037:1.text: Well... I... I'll give it a try...

say:47:1322469039:3.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll take Irina to talk to her father about this.
say:47:1322469039:3.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll take Irina to talk to her father about this.
say:47:1322469039:3.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll take Irina to talk to her father about this.

say:48:1322469040:1.text: Don't worry, I've already spoken to him, and I know how to convince him.
say:48:1322469040:1.source_cn: 你放心，我和她父亲接触过了，我有办法说服他。
say:48:1322469040:1.male: Don't worry, I've already spoken to him, and I know how to convince him.
say:48:1322469040:1.female: Don't worry, I've already spoken to him, and I know how to convince him.

say:52:1322469044:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... thank you... thank you so much.
say:52:1322469044:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... thank you... thank you so much.
say:52:1322469044:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... thank you... thank you so much.

say:53:1322469045:1.text: I'll... work hard to practice my singing… will you come... listen?
say:53:1322469045:1.source_cn: 我……努力练歌……你会来……听吗？
say:53:1322469045:1.male: I'll... work hard to practice my singing… will you come... listen?
say:53:1322469045:1.female: I'll... work hard to practice my singing… will you come... listen?

choice_prompt:54:1322469045.male: I'll... work hard to practice my singing… will you come... listen?
choice_prompt:54:1322469045.female: I'll... work hard to practice my singing… will you come... listen?

say:55:1322469046:1.text: I'll sing... really well. You... you have to come!
say:55:1322469046:1.source_cn: 我会唱得……很好。你……一定要来！
say:55:1322469046:1.male: I'll sing... really well. You... you have to come!
say:55:1322469046:1.female: I'll sing... really well. You... you have to come!

choice:43:0:1.source_cn: 你的歌声是从内心唱的

say:57:1322469024:0.text: Yeah! Lev must've been such a warm soul.
say:57:1322469024:0.source_cn: 是啊！列夫应该是个很温暖的人！

say:58:1322469025:0.text: I'm really moved, too... I had no idea Irina could sing so well!

cinematic_dialogue:2:1322450001:.text: The ritual is about to begin!

cinematic_dialogue:2:1322450002:.text: The Great Will shall bless you all!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1322450002:.source_cn: 伟大意志将会赐福与你们！

say:4:1322449001:1.text: Magister, keep an eye on the one in charge. We can't let him slip away.
say:4:1322449001:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，请您盯紧为首的那个家伙，我们一定不能让他跑了。
say:4:1322449001:1.male: Magister, keep an eye on the one in charge. We can't let him slip away.
say:4:1322449001:1.female: Magister, keep an eye on the one in charge. We can't let him slip away.

say:5:1322449002:1.text: When we were investigating the Hierophant, that guy blocked our way. Made all sorts of excuses to stop us from entering the temple.
say:5:1322449002:1.source_cn: 哼，我们调查大主教的时候，在门口拦住我们，找借口不让我...

say:6:1322449003:1.text: This time, Chippy's going to catch him for sure!
say:6:1322449003:1.source_cn: 这回满满一定要抓住他！

choice_prompt:7:1322449003.text: This time, Chippy's going to catch him for sure!
choice_prompt:7:1322449003.source_cn: 这回满满一定要抓住他！

say:8:1322449004:0.text: Yeah, we're getting her out first.
say:8:1322449004:0.source_cn: 嗯，我们一定先把她救出来。
say:8:1322449004:0.male: Yeah, we're getting her out first.
say:8:1322449004:0.female: Yeah, we're getting her out first.

say:10:1322449006:0.text: Let's do this. We can't let any of these cultists get away!
say:10:1322449006:0.source_cn: 我们立刻行动，不能放跑任何一个邪教徒！

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 你们两个先去救出伊琳娜

narration:13:13052514:0.text: You reach the heavily guarded ritual site, where the cult leader has already started the ritual.
narration:13:13052514:0.source_cn: 你们来到祭祀现场，这里守卫重重，邪教首领已经开始主持祭...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1322454001:.text: The ritual's over. Let's catch them all!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1322454001:.source_cn: 祭祀到此结束，抓住他们！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1322455001:.text: Magister, we've got Irina! She's safe!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1322455001:.source_cn: 主人，我们救出伊琳娜了！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1322456001:.text: You... you will all die for this!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1322456002:.text: You ignorant fools... surrender to the Great Will!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1322456002:.source_cn: 无知的凡人，融入伟大意志吧！
